name: hero-idea-v1
summary: Suggests one playful, original hero description for the website's Describe box: one full-body standing character with clear colours and materials, no brand, franchise or real-person names, family friendly, under 300 characters. A random seed theme and mood vary each idea.

steps.name: idea
steps.prompt: A game tool turns a short description into an original 3D character. Invent ONE playful, original hero for it. Seed for inspiration, to use loosely: a {mood} {theme}. Rules: 1. Exactly one character, shown full body and standing; no companions, mounts, crowds, vehicles or scenery. 2. Describe only how the character looks, in plain visual terms: what they are (person, creature or robot), face and hair, and clear colours and materials for the outfit, gear and accessories (for example 'a mustard wool coat with brass buttons'). 3. Original only: no brand, company, product, franchise, film, comic, game, trademarked character or real-person names, no lookalikes of a famous character, and no logos or text on clothing. 4. Family friendly: no gore, blood, injuries, nudity or anything sexual. 5. Do not name the character. No quotes, markdown, lists or line breaks. 6. Write one or two sentences of at most 240 characters in all, then end with exactly: Full body, standing, plain background. Reply with JSON only.
